---
name: Accessibility barrier
about: Report a barrier in the website, CLI, documents, forms or diagrams
labels: bug
---

## Affected output
Link, path, command or version/commit (for example HTML, PDF, DOCX, SVG or CLI).

## Task and barrier
What were you trying to do? What happened, and what would make it usable?

## Reproduction
Steps using public or synthetic content only.

## Environment (optional)
Browser, operating system, assistive technology, zoom/contrast or input method.

## Alternative format or workaround (optional)
Is the equivalent Markdown, text or HTML version usable?

Please do not include personal/clinical records, secrets or unlicensed checklist text.
Vulnerability details must be reported privately under SECURITY.md.
